## POST `/api/2.29/telemetry-metrics-policies`

**Tier:** T1+ (check: some POSTs are actions)  

Creates a new telemetry metrics policy and attaches it to arrays. One of the `attach_member_ids` or `attach_member_array_names` parameters is required. A policy must be attached to at least one array during creation.

|---|---|---|---|---|

| `names` | query | array of string | yes | A comma-separated list of resource names. |

|---|---|---|

| `name` | string | A user-specified name. The name must be locally unique and can be changed. |
